create_eval_dataset_config: create a Wav2Vec2AsrEvalDatasetSection with custom valid_split and storage_mode for ASR evaluation
create_eval_recipe_config: create a Wav2Vec2AsrEvalRecipeConfig with default omniASR_CTC_300M model and bfloat16 AMP evaluator
configure_manifest_storage: configure manifest-based dataset storage by setting storage_mode to MANIFEST in the dataset section
configure_parquet_storage: configure mixture parquet storage by setting storage_mode to MIXTURE_PARQUET in the dataset section
customize_evaluator_section: customize the EvaluatorSection with amp=True and torch.bfloat16 dtype for mixed precision evaluation
